actions: Select Wallet and unauthorized in PreviewControls.
Apply the scenario and navigate within the SPA to /w/wallet.
scenarios.expected: The assets and transactions GETs return 401; refresh failure returns 401, routes to /auth/login and hides the previous balance.
scenarios.actual: Both GETs returned 401 through the service worker; refresh returned 401; browser reached /auth/login; stale balance was not visible.

actions: Sign in Developer again after the unauthorized scenario.
Select Wallet and forbidden in PreviewControls, apply, and navigate within the SPA to /w/wallet.
scenarios.expected: Both secured GETs return 403; recoverable error remains on /w/wallet with no refresh request and no wallet balance.
scenarios.actual: Both GETs returned 403 through the service worker; Unable to load wallet appeared; URL remained /w/wallet; zero refresh requests and no stale balance were observed.

ui.notes: Partial route evidence: /w/wallet unauthorized (401 + refresh 401, redirect to /auth/login, no stale balance) and forbidden (403, recoverable error, route retained, no refresh) were observed in local Chromium/MSW.
